text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Programme for rural road construction aims at 1,200 km (750 miles) per year, says Public Works Minister Meziane.
- Legislation to be examined aimed at simplifying privatisation process, replacing two committees with single body to speed up work and allow market to set prices.
- Palestinian President Arafat says King Hassan plays major role in Middle East peace process.
- Morocco to seek agreement with European Union for a four-month "rest period" for fish stocks in place of two months.
- France intends to play important role in development of Moroccan farming.
